validation: existing VA/VB unchanged, no protected access
audio_complementarity: new realization standalone then equal average with control; reuse quarter-grid meta-fold one-SD selector only if equal gain is credible and corroborated
uncertainty: reuse frozen duplicate/prompt90 union and 2000 PCG64(20260930) multiplier draws; registered audio contrasts simultaneous; fold and delete-fold diagnostics
audio_parent_selection: prefer a credible new V-B gain with compatible V-A and positive V-A nonretrieval/CLEAN gains; otherwise retain control; lock before semantic inference

qwen.input: transcript text only; no Id, label, fold, audio or retrieval metadata
qwen.decoding: deterministic greedy constrained to exact five-label grammar
qwen.quantization: bitsandbytes NF4 4bit, double quant, FP16 compute on T4
qwen.fusion: valid emotion replaces audio; unclear retains audio; no tuned threshold
qwen.inference: one pass over each exact unique cached transcript; reuse exact duplicate strings; alignment metadata never enters model
qwen.signal: roughly +0.03 VB with compatible VA and signal outside repeated prompts/retrieval; diagnostic not an absolute cutoff
qwen.failure: kill fixed mechanism; no prompt/threshold tuning

astra_exploratory.recovery: preserved command/output from blinded diagnostic; exact IDs also reproduced with frozen ASR/duplicate artifacts and random_state20261002
